_comment: SCALE2 (spec-v2/22-scale-envelope.md, Wave F step F.2): JSON.stringify sites in packages/rendering and packages/core runtime src that produce a wire format, debug display, HOST4 clone, or Intl cache key — not a per-commit / per-render change signature. Each entry needs file, line, and a reason. Remove an entry in the same PR that deletes the call.

entries.reason: Intl cache key — formatterKey stringifies options so PluralRules / NumberFormat / DateTimeFormat can be reused (LOC3/LOC6).
Clipboard wire format — serializePenClipboardPayload writes the versioned Pen clipboard JSON.
Clipboard wire format — re-serialize a parsed payload after migration so HTML meta stays versioned JSON.
Clipboard wire format — table-cell copy writes application/x-pen-cells JSON.
Debug display — safeStringify truncates a value for the AI debug log, not a render signature.
Debug display — formatToolStreamValue pretty-prints a tool payload for the stream UI.
Drag wire format — serializeBlockDragPayload writes the HTML5 drag JSON payload.
Debug display — unknown-block fallback pretty-prints props in development only.
Clipboard wire format — writePenClipboard serializes pen-blocks onto the clipboard.
HOST4 clone fallback — structuredClone is preferred; JSON clone is only used when that API is missing.
